title: Pokémon TCG Zebstrika Paradox Rift 063/182 Reverse Holo Uncommon
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Pokémon TCG card features the character Zebstrika from the Sv04: Paradox Rift set. With a HP of 120, this Stage 1 card is a great addition to any collection. The card is an Uncommon card with a Reverse Holo finish and is numbered 063/182. 

The card is manufactured by The Pokémon Company and is in English language. It is perfect for fans of the Pokémon TCG game. This card is not autographed and is a great addition to any collection. Get your hands on this rare card today!
